call_idefics3_processor: call the Idefics3Processor to tokenize text and images for multimodal input
create_idefics3_processor: create an Idefics3Processor with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal vision-language tasks
build_image_prompt_string: build an image prompt string with expanded image tokens for split or single image inputs
create_mm_token_type_ids: create multimodal token type ids to distinguish image tokens from text tokens in input sequences
get_num_multimodal_tokens: get the number of multimodal tokens for given image sizes using the Idefics3Processor
